question: Given \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF\), \(AB=2x+1\), and \(DE=4x-7\), find the value of \(x\).
solution: \(AB\) and \(DE\) are corresponding sides and are equal: \(2x+1=4x-7\). Solving gives \(x=4\).
